div.div: Why a StatefulSet for the PDP? Raft needs stable identities (ztc-pdp-0..2 resolve via the headless Service) and durable per-replica storage (PVC). A Deployment would give random names and shared or no storage.

headless Service) and durable per-replica storage (PVC). A Deployment would give random
names and shared or no storage.
